# voipms_callback (Resource)

Manages a callback (`setCallback` / `delCallback`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "voipms_callback" "mobile" {
  description      = "Mobile"
  number           = "15550002001"
  callerid_number  = "5550001002"
  delay_before     = 5
  response_timeout = 10
  digit_timeout    = 5
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `number` (String) Number VoIP.ms calls to start the callback.

### Optional

- `callerid_number` (String) Caller ID presented to the callback number.
- `delay_before` (Number) Seconds to wait before sending the callback prompt.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `digit_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait between DTMF digits.
- `response_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait for DTMF after the prompt.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) VoIP.ms callback id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import voipms_callback.mobile 3001
```
